Eight independent six-cycle lifts imply rank_Q ∂2≤154, while exact F3 reduction gives ≥154; hence b1=8 and H2=ker Z^168→Z^252 is free rank14. Character inner products give absolutely irreducible 8+6 rational summands. No claim about integral splitting or full H1 torsion. Existing prior source verifies same character and an integral geometric torus basis.
